description: Word, Excel and PowerPoint creation, verified OOXML text edits, engine edits with explicit capability limits, and file conversion.
name: Office Documents

releaseNotes.en: document.office.edit supports runtime-authorized automatic copy execution: a service-owned engine session opens, executes, saves and reopen-verifies an isolated copy while the original stays unchanged. Excel recalculation is verified from persisted cached values/types/errors against the dependency context; selection-relative commands are unavailable in automatic mode. When the app has registered the authorized Office job adapter, an authorized apply can also be submitted through jobs.submit: the submission consumes the runtime approval for that exact jobs.submit call and freezes the proposal revision and concrete commands, and the job writes the verified copy on the frozen task workspace; without an adapter apply stays inline-only. Eligible jobs submitted by a delegated child keep the same effective parent capability ceiling, and delegation or main-run-only capabilities can never be deferred. Cancellation is cooperative and truthful: a running job reports cancelling until its processor stops and staging cleanup completes; an interrupted job's outcome is UNKNOWN and must be inspected read-only before retrying.
releaseNotes.zh-Hans: document.office.edit 支持经运行时授权的自动副本执行：在隔离副本上打开服务自有引擎会话、执行、保存、重开校验，原文件保持不变；Excel 重算按重开后持久化的缓存值/类型/错误与依赖上下文校验，选择相关命令在自动模式下不可用。注册了授权 Office 作业适配器时，授权 apply 也可通过 jobs.submit 提交：提交时即消费该 jobs.submit 调用的运行时批准并冻结提案修订与具体命令，后台作业在冻结的任务工作区写入已校验副本；未注册适配器时 apply 仍仅限内联。子代理提交的合格作业沿用同一父级能力上限，委派与仅主运行能力永不被延后。取消是真实且协作式的：运行中作业先显示正在取消，处理器停止并完成暂存清理后才转为已取消；进程中断的作业结果视为未知，应先只读检查再重试。
